description: This file defines the SuiteEditorTinyMCE class, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface to integrate the TinyMCE editor into SuiteCRM. It includes class properties and methods for setting up editor settings and generating HTML output via Smarty templating.

classes.name: SuiteEditorTinyMCE
classes.description: A class that utilizes the TinyMCE editor as a SuiteEditor in SuiteCRM, implementing setup and HTML rendering functionalities.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the editor with optional SuiteEditorSettings.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML code for the editor using Smarty templating.
